notes.title: Pre-Order Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion & Prepare for War in New Trailer
notes.content: [h3][i]"How many have sacrificed their lives in pursuit of a sliver of happiness?"[/i] [/h3][p][/p][p]Debuting at IGN Live, the all-new story trailer for [i]Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion[/i] sets up an epic battle between humans, Outers, and Immortals that’s rife with action and intrigue. Get a glimpse at the cast of characters you’ll side with and fight against. Feel the pulse of the soundtrack backing epic battles between Arsenals, clashing over the fate of humanity. [/p][p]The battle ignites on September 5![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="1PBUqSBwyWE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]On top of that new trailer, we’ve also started pre-orders for [i]Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion[/i]! This action-packed new entry in the [i]Daemon X Machina[/i] series will be available in a standard edition for $69.99.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1342490/Daemon_X_Machina_Titanic_Scion/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]A Digital Deluxe Edition, which includes the game and access to substantial post-launch DLC, featuring new story content and customization options for your Arsenal and Outer, for $89.99.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/sub/1329421/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Or a Super Digital Deluxe Edition which includes the game, the aforementioned DLC sets, a digital soundtrack, and a digital art book, for $99.99. [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/sub/1329422/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]All digital pre-orders will get the “Special Equipment Set” DLC as a bonus, which includes the “Bahamut” Arsenal Skin, the Beguiling Suit (Outer Suit), and the Special Equipment – Victorious Gleam (Laser Blade), as well as the “Purchase Bonus Item Set” DLC, which includes the Special Equipment – Variable Breadth (Longbow), Bonus Attachment Set 1, and Bonus Item Set.[/p]
